questions.question: Unemployment that occurs during recessions and depressions are called as _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclical unemployment**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclical unemployment** occurs when there is a lack of demand for goods and services in the economy, leading to a reduction in production and, consequently, a reduction in the workforce.
 
• This type of unemployment is directly related to the economic cycle of growth and recession.
 
• During periods of economic downturns such as recessions and depressions, cyclical unemployment tends to increase as companies reduce their output and lay off workers.
 
• It contrasts with other types of unemployment such as frictional, structural, and seasonal unemployment, which are not directly tied to the economic cycle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disguised unemployment** refers to a situation where more people are employed than actually needed, often seen in agricultural sectors in developing countries.
 
• **Frictional unemployment** occurs when workers are temporarily between jobs or are searching for new ones.
 
• **Seasonal unemployment** occurs when people are unemployed at certain times of the year when demand for labor is lower, such as agricultural workers during the off-season.
 
• **Structural unemployment** happens when there is a mismatch between the skills of the workforce and the needs of the industry.

questions.question: Tipu Sultan became the ruler of Mysore in _______.
questions.solution:

• **Tipu Sultan** became the ruler of Mysore in the year **1782**.
 
• He succeeded his father, Sultan Hyder Ali, who was the previous ruler of Mysore.
 
• Tipu Sultan is also known as the 'Tiger of Mysore' and is remembered for his resistance against British colonialism.
 
• During his reign, he introduced several administrative innovations and attempted to modernize the military.

• Tipu Sultan's rule ended with his death on **4th May 1799** during the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War when the British forces captured Srirangapatna.
 
• He is a controversial figure in Indian history, with differing perspectives on his legacy.

questions.question:
Which of the following is correct regarding green revolution In India?

I. During green revolution, shifting from traditional farming to monoculture had negative effects on small farmers.

II. One of the impacts of green revolution is over - capitalization in Agriculture.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Both I and II** are correct statements regarding the Green Revolution in India.
 
• During the Green Revolution, the shift from traditional farming to monoculture had negative effects on small farmers, primarily because they couldn't afford the high-yield variety seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides.
 
• One of the impacts of the Green Revolution was over-capitalization in agriculture, leading to increased investment in machinery and equipment, which further disadvantaged small farmers who couldn't afford these investments.
 
• The Green Revolution led to increased agricultural productivity, but it also resulted in socio-economic disparities and environmental concerns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Green Revolution in India began in the 1960s and was aimed at making the country self-sufficient in food grain production.
 
• It involved the adoption of new agricultural techniques, including the use of high-yield variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and advanced irrigation methods.
 
• While it led to significant increases in food grain production, especially wheat and rice, it also caused issues like soil degradation, depletion of water resources, and increased inequality among farmers.

questions.question: What is the basic unit of time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Second (s)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The basic unit of time is the **second (s)**.
 
• It is one of the seven base units in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• The second is defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the **cesium frequency, ΔνCₛ**, the unperturbed ground-state hyperfine transition frequency of the cesium-133 atom, to be 9,192,631,770 when expressed in the unit Hz, which is equal to s⁻¹.
 
• This definition was adopted in 1967 by the International Committee for Weights and Measures (CIPM).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The second is used to measure time intervals and is crucial in various fields such as physics, engineering, and everyday life.
 
• Modern timekeeping devices, like atomic clocks, provide extremely accurate measurements of the second.
 
• Other units of time, like minutes and hours, are derived from the second.

questions.question:
Read the following statements about Money.

A. Money also acts as a convenient unit of account.

B. The value of all goods and services can be expressed in monetary units.

Identify the CORRECT statement/statements.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Both statements A and B about money are correct.
 
• **Statement A**: Money acts as a convenient unit of account, meaning it provides a standard numerical unit of measurement for the market value of goods, services, and other transactions.
 
• **Statement B**: The value of all goods and services can be expressed in monetary units, which simplifies the process of comparing prices and costs in an economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Money serves several functions in an economy, including being a medium of exchange, a store of value, and a unit of account.
 
• As a unit of account, money allows for the consistent valuation and comparison of goods and services, facilitating trade and economic planning.
 
• The use of money as a unit of account is essential for budgeting, accounting, and financial reporting.
 
• Without a common unit of account, it would be challenging to measure and compare the value of different goods and services, complicating economic transactions.

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Mauryan empire?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the founder of the Mauryan Empire.
 
• He established the empire in **321 BCE** after overthrowing the Nanda dynasty.
 
• Under his rule, the Mauryan Empire expanded significantly, encompassing a large part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Chandragupta was mentored by the famous scholar and advisor **Chanakya (Kautilya)**, who played a crucial role in his rise to power.
 
• His reign marked the beginning of a centralized and bureaucratic governance system in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Mauryan Empire is considered one of the largest and most powerful political and military empires of ancient India.
 
• Chandragupta's grandson, **Ashoka the Great**, is one of the most celebrated rulers of the Mauryan dynasty, known for his role in spreading Buddhism across Asia.
 
• The Mauryan administration was highly organized with a complex system of governance that included a central treasury, a network of spies, and a standing army.
 
• Chandragupta Maurya eventually abdicated the throne and became a Jain monk, spending his last years in Karnataka, South India.
